verdict.rationale: OCI's own IAM documents policies that govern control of resources, which is the scoping mechanism. It also offers token-based authentication for the CLI as an alternative credential. Neither item explicitly shows issuing a dedicated, least-privilege API credential for an agent. Missing for 10: documentation of creating per-agent API keys or principals, binding fine-grained least-privilege policies to those credentials, credential expiry and rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: IAM policies govern control of resources in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) tenancies.
To use the CLI without a keypair, you can use token-based authentication.
IAM uses identity domains to provide identity and access management features such as authentication, single sign-on (SSO), and identity lifecycle management
